checks.name: Issuer key pinned
checks.detail: Obtain the issuer key through a separate trusted channel.

checks.name: Application signature
checks.detail: Ed25519 protects the exported application assertions.

checks.name: Environment binding
checks.detail: Synthetic evidence is never live evidence.

checks.name: Delivery binding
checks.detail: Delivered digest must equal the approved digest.

checks.name: Settlement binding
checks.detail: Transaction, recipient, asset, chain, and amounts stay linked.

checks.name: Provider quote signature
checks.detail: Official SDK production manager key; this does not sign provider execution status.

checks.name: Quote policy binding
checks.detail: Executable quote must satisfy the original authorization at its quoted timestamp; a dry quote cannot prove execution.

checks.name: Provider transaction association
checks.detail: Signed quote and confirmed source stay bound; additional references must be origin-chain refunds. Provider status itself is an unsigned assertion.

checks.name: Independent destination RPC
checks.detail: Canonical successful token transfer, confirmations and finality observed.

checks.name: Independent origin refund RPC
checks.detail: Re-query the origin chain to distinguish an origin refund from a second destination payment.
